customManagers.description: OpenWrt package Makefiles annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' above PKG_VERSION; a bump resets PKG_RELEASE to 1

Pins of components built into a package: '# renovate: datasource=... depName=... packageName=...' above '<NAME>_VERSION:=v<version>', or with a trailing 'branch=<branch>' above '<NAME>_VERSION:=<commit sha>' for sources without release tags

packageRules.description: Commit/PR title in the feed's style: '<package>: update to <version>'
Component pins: '<package>: update <component> to <version>', and PKG_RELEASE is incremented (the command has to be in allowedCommands, see renovate.yml)
GitHub Actions: one PR per action, as dependabot did
